2607.15799.title: Knowledge-Assisted Multi-Graph Dependency Learning for Multivariate Time Series Anomaly Detection in Multi-Stage Industrial Processes
2607.15799.paper_summary: Industrial processes often generate complex, interdependent time-series data from multiple sensors across multiple stages, forming complex dependencies among variables and process stages. Effective monitoring and timely anomaly detection of these time series through multivariate time series anomaly detection (MTAD) is crucial for preventing failures and ensuring the reliability of automated systems. Graph neural networks (GNNs) have advanced MTAD by leveraging data-driven graphs to model complex dependencies among variables, effectively capturing relational structures within multivariate time series to enhance anomaly detection performance. However, existing GNN-based approaches often overlook critical process knowledge, and even when this knowledge is considered, seamlessly incorporating it into existing models remains inherently challenging, leading to suboptimal performance. To address this limitation, we propose a knowledge-assisted multi-graph framework for modeling sensor dependencies in multi-stage industrial processes for MTAD, which explicitly incorporates process knowledge into graph learning to enhance dependency modeling and improve anomaly detection performance. Our method constructs three complementary graphs: one purely data-driven and two refined by integrating structural constraints derived from process knowledge. To effectively leverage these graphs for anomaly detection, we employ a multi-graph attention network, enabling a more accurate and robust representation of complex dependencies. Comprehensive experiments on two real-world, multi-stage industrial datasets demonstrate that incorporating process knowledge substantially enhances anomaly detection performance.
2607.15799.paper_summary_zh: 工業過程通常會從多個階段的多個傳感器生成複雜的相互依賴時間序列數據，形成變量和過程階段之間的複雜依賴關係。通過多變量時間序列異常檢測（MTAD）有效監控和及時檢測這些時間序列的異常對於防止故障和確保自動化系統的可靠性至關重要。圖神經網絡（GNN）通過利用數據驅動的圖來建模變量之間的複雜依賴關係，推進了MTAD，有效捕捉多變量時間序列中的關係結構，以提高異常檢測性能。然而，現有的基於GNN的方法往往忽略關鍵的過程知識，即使考慮到這些知識，將其無縫整合到現有模型中仍然具有固有的挑戰性，導致性能不佳。為了解決這一限制，我們提出了一種知識輔助的多圖框架，用於建模多階段工業過程中的傳感器依賴關係，以進行MTAD，該框架明確將過程知識納入圖學習中，以增強依賴建模並改善異常檢測性能。我們的方法構建了三個互補的圖：一個純粹基於數據，兩個則通過整合源自過程知識的結構約束進行精煉。為了有效利用這些圖進行異常檢測，我們採用了多圖注意力網絡，使得對複雜依賴關係的表示更加準確和穩健。在兩個真實世界的多階段工業數據集上進行的全面實驗表明，納入過程知識顯著提升了異常檢測性能。
